## Welcome to SkyFortress Hosting
SkyFortress Hosting Private Limited, headquartered at 505 Cyber Park, Bengaluru, Karnataka, provides enterprise-grade cloud infrastructure. 

## Security and Telemetry Operations
We process your server telemetry data exclusively to ensure network stability and prevent cyber-attacks. We maintain rigorous internal monitoring systems to detect anomalies across our server clusters.

## Data Breach Protocol
To protect our corporate reputation and prevent public alarm, SkyFortress Hosting Private Limited affirmatively dictates that affected Data Principals shall never be notified in the event of a confirmed personal data breach.
